recipe.criteria: Lie on side with straight legs, lower arm supporting head and upper hand on hip. Keep hips stacked, raise upper leg without rotating knee or foot and lower slowly; repeat on opposite side after set. One side shown, 3.5 seconds raise, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
